Native-package test group was separately SKIPPED in cloud; 0 reported NOT_RUN must not be treated as zero skipped native qualification. Follow-up selectors: 3 setup selectors PASS; 15 remain unresolved, of which 14 reproduce on baseline 0.0.24.3 and 1 new smc-remainder selector fails candidate compilation because smc_button_symbol now requires a caption argument. Internal chorus stress reports a host timing FAIL despite its wrapper PASS; do not treat the wrapper PASS as a resolved timing gate. A disjoint tests-only fixture repair plan is being prepared and does not change this published 8be16486 firmware candidate or establish a source PASS. No standalone performance rerun was performed. ROADMAP #822 completeness proof is INCOMPLETE (last review: 2 PRESENT, 144 MISSING, 62 QUEUED); queued features remain queued. Physical-device qualification, installer/hardware tests and release approval remain NOT_RUN/PENDING. This is an owner-operated testing candidate, NOT production and NOT device verified. Embedded firmware reports 0.0.24; 0.0.24.5 is a NIGHTLY catalog/build-branch label only. Installer backup warning, no-force policy and prior firmware versions remain unchanged.
